content.text: The Bachelor’s of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery is a five and a half year undergraduate course. It helps the students to combine traditional Ayurvedic medicine with modern medical practices. The eligibility for the BAMS course requires the candidate to qualify for the NEET exam. Three colleges provide BAMS admission in Andhra Pradesh. One of them is a government college, and the other two are private. The Government college holds 75 seats for BAMS admission every year, and the private ones have 90 seats each. In this article, we will cover the important details regarding BAMS admission in Andhra Pradesh, including the list of colleges, their eligibility, and fees.

sections.heading: How to Take BAMS Admission in Andhra Pradesh

content.text: For BAMS admission in India , colleges solicit students who are eligible for BAMS admission via the NEET merit. NCISM, New Delhi, Ministry of Ayush, has stated that there shall not be any offline admission or admission without counselling (Central/State/UT). And any admissions in contravention of this shall not be approved. Hence, all admissions under Management will be conducted by Dr. NTR UHS, Vijayawada , only(They are the only counselling authority for Andhra Pradesh Ayush Counselling ). In total, there are 255 seats available for BAMS admission in Andhra Pradesh.

sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria for BAMS Admission in Andhra Pradesh

content.text: In the state of Andhra Pradesh, the eligibility criteria for BAMS admission are pretty much the same as in any other state in the country. BAMS eligibility in Andhra Pradesh requires the students to pass NEET with a minimum required marks and attend the AYUSH state counselling process to book seats at their desired colleges. The eligibility guidelines are as follows.
Entrance Exam: The National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET UG)
Academic Qualification:

items: Candidates need to score a minimum of 50% aggregate in the Physics, Chemistry, and Biology subjects in their 12th examination. There is a relaxation of aggregate marks for the reserved candidates (Minimum 40% aggregate for SC/ST students)
Students must pass the 10+2 board examination from a recognised board.
Students should have passed the science stream with subjects Physics, Chemistry, and Biology/Biochemistry.

content.text: Age Limit: Candidates should have completed the age of 17 years as on the 31st December of the previous year.

sections.heading: BAMS Admission Process in Andhra Pradesh

content.text: Dr. NTR University of Health Science oversees the whole procedure for BAMS admission in Andhra Pradesh. The National Commission for Indian System of Medicine (NCISM) and the Ministry of AYUSH made a statement that no offline admission is permitted to the course. Only the admission done through the proper counselling process will be entertained. The whole admission is broken down into a step-by-step process for you below.
Step 1: Appear and qualify for the NEET-UG examination of the concluding year.
Step 2: Visit the official website of Dr. NTR University of Health Science and fill out the application form with accurate details about personal and academic information.

Step 3: Submitting the application form will generate a registration number. The registration number will be sent to your registered mobile number or email. (Registration Fees for UR/OBS category are INR 2950/- (2500+450(GST@18%)), and for SC/ST category are INR 2360/- (2000/-+340(GST@18%)).
Step 4: Participate in the counselling session conducted by the counselling authority. The final allotment list will be published on their official website.
Step 5: The candidates who are on the list must report to the college and complete verification of documents. Carry all of your relevant documents, both in originals and photocopies.
Step 6: Lastly, you need to confirm your seat allotment to the allotted college by paying the prescribed fees.

Remember, applying for the BAMS admission in Andhra Pradesh does not guarantee your seats. If false or inaccurate information is found on the application form, the counselling authority can cancel the candidature at any time.

sections.heading: Documents Required for Admission

content.text: The BAMS admission in Andhra Pradesh requires a list of documents at the time of application and the verification procedure. The documents are prescribed as per the counselling authority, Dr. NTR University of Health Sciences.

items: NEET UG Rank Card (Mandatory)
NEET UG Admit Card (Mandatory)
Date of Birth Certificate (SSC Marks Memo). (Mandatory)
Qualifying Exam Certificate (Intermediate Marks Memo OR Equivalent – Grade Certificate not Accepted) (Mandatory)
Study Certificate from sixth to Intermediate (VI to XII).
Caste Certificate (If applicable)
Income Certificate (If applicable)
Discontinuation Bond ( Rs. 100/- Non Judicial Stamp Paper ).
PwD Certificate (If applicable)
Aadhar Card
Candidate’s Latest passport-size Photo
Specimen Signature of the Candidate

content.text: Keep 05 sets of photocopies of each document mentioned above.

sections.heading: BAMS Fees in Andhra Pradesh

content.text: BAMS fees in Andhra Pradesh are low compared to those in other states of India. Here, the course fees are collected in instalments at the start of each year. The details of the fees are given below.

sections.heading: BAMS Careers in Andhra Pradesh

content.text: BAMS offers a wide range of career opportunities. Students who complete this degree from Andhra Pradesh BAMS colleges get jobs in different hospitals and nursing homes. Some of the BAMS jobs in Andhra Pradesh are as Ayurvedic Doctors, Medical Officers, Consultant Doctors, Ayurveda Therapists, and Medical Writers in the government and private sectors. Manasa Ayurvedic Research Centre features Ayurvedic doctor jobs in the state. Additionally, BAMS graduates can explore opportunities in areas like medical tourism, academics, and the pharmaceutical industry.

Most colleges in the state, such as Dr. NR Shastry, the Govt. Ayurvedic College has a 100% placement record in the previous years. Their career guidance helps the students with their choice of career. Andhra Pradesh also offers colleges with PG courses, if the BAMS graduates want to pursue higher and advanced studies.

sections.heading: Conclusion

content.text: As NEET is necessary for BAMS admission in Andhra Pradesh, students must score a minimum mark in the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test. Admission to the course in all the colleges in Andhra Pradesh is only through the AP Ayush Counselling conducted by the Dr NTR University of Health Sciences. The state has a total of 3 colleges for BAMS with a very affordable fee structure.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
Is there any entrance exam for BAMS admission in Andhra Pradesh?

content.text: Yes, NEET UG exam qualification is mandatory for BAMS admission in Andhra Pradesh.

sections.heading: How to take BAMS admission in Andhra Pradesh?

content.text: After qualifying NEET UG, fill out the application form and submit it online on the website of Dr. NTRUHS, Vijayawada. Participate in the counseling.

sections.heading: Which is the Andhra Pradesh BAMS counselling authority?

content.text: Dr. NTR University of Health Science is the Andhra Pradesh BAMS counselling authority.

sections.heading: What are the eligibility criteria for BAMS admission in Andhra Pradesh?

content.text: The eligibility for admission into the BAMS course is that a candidate must have passed the two-year Pre-University or Plus Two or 12th examination or Intermediate or equivalent with Science subjects, obtaining at least 50% aggregate marks in Physics, Chemistry, and Biology. The candidate also has to be 17 years of age as on 31st December of the current year.

sections.heading: What are the BAMS fees in Andhra Pradesh?

content.text: The fees for BAMS in Andhra Pradesh range from INR 12,000/- to INR 60,000/-. The fees are paid on a yearly basis.

sections.heading: Are there hostels available in the BAMS college in Andhra Pradesh?

content.text: Yes, both boys’ and girls’ hostels are available in BAMS college in Andhra Pradesh. Hostel fees are to be paid separately from the course fees.

sections.heading: Which are the top BAMS colleges in Andhra Pradesh?

content.text: Dr. NR Shastry, Govt. Ayurvedic College, Sri Venkateswara Ayurvedic College, Sri Adi Shiva Sadguru Alli Saheb Sivaaryula Ayurvedic Medical College and Research Centre are the top colleges for BAMS in Andhra Pradesh.

sections.heading: How many BAMS colleges are there in AP?

content.text: There are a total of 3 BAMS colleges in AP. One of them is a Government college, and the other two are Private.

sections.heading: What is the fees of BAMS private college in Andhra Pradesh?

content.text: Private colleges in Andhra Pradesh charge a fee of INR 60k on average per year for the BAMS course.
